		<p style="margin: 0px 0px 15px; color: #263034; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px;">Some of the world&#8217;s leading websitesincluding those owned or operated by Bank of America, VMware, the US Department of Veteran&#8217;s Affairs, and business consultancy Accenture—are vulnerable to simple attacks that bypass the transport layer security encryption designed to thwart eavesdroppers and spoofers. The attacks are a variation on the&nbsp;<a style="color: #699fb3;" href="http://arstechnica.com/security/2014/10/ssl-broken-again-in-poodle-attack/">so-called POODLE exploits disclosed two months ago</a>&nbsp;.</p>
